cards.quote: Patrick Schuenke, a distinguished researcher in the field of materials science, shared insights into his groundbreaking work during his tenure at Georgia Tech, a public research university in Atlanta, Georgia. Schuenke, whose ORCID ID is 0000-0002-3179-4830, is widely recognized for his contributions to the development of advanced materials with unique properties. His research has far-reaching implications for industries such as aerospace, energy, and healthcare. During his time at Georgia Tech, Schuenke led a team of researchers in the university's prestigious School of Materials Science and Engineering.
